card.name: Unix command-line terminal output
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation inside pasted Unix or BSD shell sessions, such as password prompts, device listings and service restart messages. It fires on the prompt or output text, not on the commands themselves.

modes.label: Password prompts
modes.description: Words in the adduser or htpasswd password dialogue and its confirmation line.
modes.example: asswd adduser username <<New>> password: Re-type new password: User

modes.label: System output lines
modes.description: Pieces of device, disk or service status output in a terminal log.
modes.example: Shutting down http<<:>> [ OK ] Starting httpd: [

card.plain: It lights up on text copied from a Unix terminal session, like password prompts and system status lines.
